scope.summary: Produce the visual QA capture set per Section 13.27: an Argus-driven capture matrix per archetype (front/side/three-quarter neutral, pose extremes, genital closeups where relevant) persisted as CAP- rows correlated to recipe id and channel-state hash — the standing visual evidence surface for validators and operator review (OBR implications 5 render-test leg, HBR-VIS for QA bodies).
acceptance_criteria: For each archetype the capture set includes: front/side/three-quarter neutral at bake-level shading, pose-extreme shots (thigh spread, deep squat, deep arch from the QA pose set), and genital closeups on the archetypes where genital config is load-bearing (A, F, G, H).
Captures run headlessly via Argus/capture_view with named presets — no GUI shell, no foreground window — and are deterministic in framing (preset camera transforms pinned).
Every capture persists as a CAP- row correlated to recipe id + channel-state hash + pose id; a recipe or channel change marks dependent captures stale (never silently reused).
The capture set is enumerable per archetype through the API so validator sessions and operator review pull the same rows (no parallel screenshot stores).
Re-running with unchanged state is idempotent (no duplicate rows); the run completes within the CI long-lane budget.
scope.risk_if_missed: Visual acceptance — the only leg that catches 'technically valid but looks wrong' failures on extreme bodies — has no standing evidence, so validators either skip inspection or burn time hand-capturing unreproducible screenshots.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
